results.title: Tokio vs async-std vs smol: choosing a Rust async runtime
results.author: A. Writer
highlights: Tokio remains the default choice for network services, while smol keeps the dependency tree small.
In our benchmark Tokio's multi-thread scheduler led on throughput by roughly 18 percent.
